text:
maria: Quick check — we're planning to ramp model-v12 tonight to 10% global. Can we hold EU at 2% until latency looks good?

devin: On it. Is there an existing flag that can scope by region? I only see global_percent in the UI for v12.

kevin: There is a region_override but it wasn't wired for v12 rollouts yet. Sasha opened a PR to eng-platform (#1421) to add that. Devin, can you take a look?

devin: Reviewing now. If we keep EU at 2% we should add an automatic fallback to v11 when p95 > 350ms — otherwise we'll get customer-visible slow responses.

opsbot: Deploy bot: scheduled rollout for model-v12 at 2026-04-01T02:00Z. Canary monitors configured to alert on p95 latency and error_rate.

sasha: PR comments posted, added region_override wiring and a tiny CLI helper to patch flags during rollout: `./tools/patch-flag --flag model_v12 --region eu --percent 2`

kevin: Also want to gate the ramp on model-quality evals. If the eval regresses >1% on the latest prompt set, we should auto-pause. Can we wire that signal into the rollout controller?

maria: Plan proposal: 1) enable global @ 1% 2) confirm telemetry for 30m 3) bump EU -> 2% only if latency/p95 stable 4) infra auto-fallback to v11 on p95 > 350ms and/or eval regression >1%. Devin/Keven/Sasha — please add a thumbs in the PR when you've confirmed the change. :thumbsup:

devin: :thumbsup: testing the patch locally now, will push a small unit test and update PR.

sasha: Added a short runbook snippet in the PR (how to abort):
```
curl -X POST $FLAG_API/override -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"flag":"model_v12","region":"eu","percent":0}'
```

kevin: I'll be on-call during the ramp window. If anything odd, ping #eng-oncall and @kevin. Quick dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc/model-v12-canary — please bookmark.

maria: Great. No objections so far; I'm marking the rollout window in the schedule doc and will update stakeholders. If we get the thumbs in the PR within the hour, we proceed with the staged flow. Thanks all!
